liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell In A Bucket** (1 review): The show opens with a tight, energetic Hell in a Bucket [22]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Sugaree is standard until a standout solo around the 6:30 mark [16]
- **Tons of Steel** (1 review): Tons of Steel was played in response to a loudly shouted request [16]
- **Drums** (1 review): Around 9:13 into Drums, something startling happens that the listener had not heard in over 60 shows [25]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Not Fade Away is a highlight, with the crowd chanting along [22]

## The recordings

- **gd87-06-14.sbd.clugston.11896.sbefail.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 165 min; rated 4.08/5 by 12 [1]. Said about its sound: The stream sounds clear, with good energy and a tight performance [21]
- **gd1987-06-14.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83755.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 166 min; rated 3/5 by 7 [2]
- **gd1987-06-14.sbd.painoman.17347.shnf**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 165 min [3]
- **gd1987-06-14.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-11896.75505.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 164 min [4]

## Around the show

- Huge fires burned in the inland mountains that day, which the listener linked to the second-set Fire on the Mountain [14]
- A Steal Your Face flag was fluttering in the breeze during the show [14]
- The day was sunny, and the rodeo fairgrounds stood right beside the beach [15]
- The grounds had a dirt floor with big clods, wooden ad-covered fences, the stage at one end, and bleachers [15]
- An afternoon sea breeze blew through the crowd and made the sound windy for the listener in the audience [18]
- Camping was a big part of the scene, and the listener believes Ventura later banned the band [18]
- The venue sat close to the ocean, with a nice backdrop behind the stage [20]
- Many fans camped on the beach for this show [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd87-06-14.sbd.clugston.11896.sbefail.shnf**: source: Master Soundboard Cassette > PCM > DAT> CDR [1]. Also: Clugston converted to SHN with EAC and seeded to etree, and also sent it to abgd via Charlie Connor [1]
- **gd1987-06-14.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.83755.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG90/Sony D5) [2]. Also: Tapes came from Paul Scotton and Joani Walker, with David Minches supplying the patch source [2]
- **gd1987-06-14.sbd.painoman.17347.shnf**: transferred by Chris Paino; source: Matrix SBD>CASS>DAT>CD [3]. Also: A fade out and in between Ramble On Rose and Me and My Uncle was crossfaded into a seamless join; Seamless flow of the second set was restored; extraction used Exact Audio Copy in secure mode [3]
- **gd1987-06-14.sbd.clugston.tetzeli.fix-11896.75505.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Seamless fix of shnid 11896 [4]. Also: A fade at the end of CD 2 was reversed and redundant material deleted, making the CD 3 transition seamless; Shntool fixed SBEs in CD 3; one at the end of CD 1 was left, and files became FLAC [4]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Ron Delany Grateful Dead: [1987-06-12 Ventura County Fairgrounds, Ventura, CA, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1987-06-12-ventura-county-fairgrounds-ventura-ca-usa/) [27]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead County Fairgrounds - June 14, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/june-14-1987) [28]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead County Fairgrounds - June 14, 1987](https://www.dead.net/show/june-14-1987) [29]
- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Jerry Garcia](https://www.dead.net/archives/1987/photos/jerry-garcia-3) [30]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-06-14 Grateful Dead Backstage Pass - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-06-14-grateful-dead-backstage-pass/) [31]
- Poster by Jerry Garcia: [1987-06-14 Grateful Dead Ticket - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/1987-06-14-grateful-dead-ticket/) [32]
